##### Project general facts

Reem Five is a residential complex developed by SAAS Properties, featuring eight residential floors and a ground floor. The architectural design blends contemporary aesthetics with elements that complement the surrounding landscape on Reem Island. The project provides a range of residence formats including studios, one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and three-bedroom apartments, each designed to maximize comfort and style. Floor-to-ceiling windows throughout each residence maximize natural light and offer expansive views of the nearby beaches, mangroves, and coastline.

The interior design emphasizes natural light and sophisticated materials. Living areas feature modern authentic parquet flooring, built-in accent lighting, and subtle shelving. Kitchens incorporate wooden cabinets, glass display cupboards, and top-of-the-line appliances. Bedrooms offer floor-to-ceiling wooden tiles, accent lighting, and ample closet space. Bathrooms are accented with marble, smart sensors integrated into mirrors, and strategically placed lighting fixtures to create a luxurious experience.

The residences are delivered unfurnished, providing a blank canvas for personal customization. The entryways are designed to open into outdoor views, seamlessly connecting indoor and outdoor living. The concierge team is available 24/7 to assist residents.

##### Location description and benefits

Reem Island is a thriving and dynamic community located in Abu Dhabi. As one of the city's most sought-after residential and commercial districts, Reem Island offers a seamless blend of modern living and picturesque waterfront views.

The community boasts a diverse range of residential options, from luxurious apartments and penthouses to spacious villas, catering to the needs of residents from various walks of life. With its well-planned infrastructure and excellent amenities, Reem Island provides a comfortable and convenient lifestyle for its residents.

Reem Island is not only a residential haven but also a vibrant commercial hub, featuring a wide array of retail outlets, restaurants, and entertainment venues. Residents and visitors can enjoy leisurely strolls along the scenic promenades or unwind in the lush parks and recreational areas that dot the island.

Beyond its urban appeal, Reem Island also offers access to pristine beaches and recreational facilities, providing opportunities for outdoor activities and water sports. Its strategic location ensures easy access to Abu Dhabi's key landmarks and business districts, making it an ideal choice for professionals and families alike.

Embrace the cosmopolitan charm and unmatched livability of Reem Island, where modernity meets nature, creating a community that is both captivating and inviting for all.
